meta.about: "Hide" reaching edit_text instead of style_node. The same address-as-`find` refusal recovers it, and the retry dispatches a DIFFERENT tool.
meta.recorded-outcome: asked to hide the last bullet, Gemma emitted edit_text({"target": "bullet 4", "find": "bullet 4", "text": ""}). Wrong tool — hiding is a style — and `find` holding an address rather than wording. style_node's summary is one sentence, so the `display: none` sentence in its description never reaches the model at all; the refusal is the only place that advice can arrive.
meta.guards: the second reply calls a tool the first turn never mentioned, which only works because `respond.js` re-resolves the name on a retry. Narrow that to the same tool, or drop `retry: true` from the address-as-`find` refusal, and this consumes one reply.
